asset_heavy.reason: Biomanufacturing of tissue products needs some plants, but it is a modest-scale specialty manufacturer, not heavy infrastructure.

big_ticket.reason: Wound care and surgical tissue products are bought repeatedly in modest per-unit amounts by clinicians.

cyclical_demand.reason: Wound care and surgical healing products are medically needed and reimbursed, so demand holds in recessions.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are clinicians, wound care clinics, physician offices and hospitals, plus government payers like Medicare, not large enterprises.

notes: Buyers are mostly clinicians and providers; patients are end users but do not choose or buy directly.

offers_products.reason: Sells regenerative tissue products such as skin substitutes, wound care and surgical biologics like Apligraf and Dermagraft.

offers_services.reason: Reimbursement support and Circle of Care assist product sales; the revenue comes from products.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for biomanufactured tissue products, not for staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Clinicians reorder wound care products repeatedly for ongoing patient treatment, though without subscriptions.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sold to clinicians, clinics and hospitals who choose the products; patients do not buy directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to physician practices, wound care centers, hospitals and government healthcare facilities such as the VA.
